summary.text: Sarah Zabel is an independent candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District. A U.S. Air Force Academy graduate, she served in the Air Force from 1987 to 2018 and retired as a major general, then wrote a book on depression and worked as an adjunct for the RAND Corporation. She entered the race in November 2025, saying she is offering an alternative to the major parties.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1987, and earned graduate degrees from the University of Texas at San Antonio (1996) and the U.S. Army War College (2007).
Served in the U.S. Air Force from 1987 to 2018, retiring as a major general.
Worked in computer systems and cybersecurity during about three decades of military service, according to the Idaho Press.
Wrote a book about the science of depression and became an adjunct for the RAND Corporation, according to her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.
Moved to Idaho in 2020 and, according to the Idaho Press, was a registered Republican until about 2018; she is now running as an independent.

Entered the race for Congress as an independent in November 2025; the Idaho Press reports she cited polarization in her community during the 2024 presidential election and has put $30,000 of her own money into the campaign.
